text: Jordan renewed the lease at Groundwork just under the deadline—one year, $150 more—deciding not to let the still-uncertain Northlight job dictate housing choices. They also had a third version of the recurring office dream, but this time found the stairs and got out, which felt meaningful even though Jordan resists reading it as causal, especially with an onsite interview on the 24th landing awkwardly close to Priya's first days as manager on the 21st. Overall the mood is settled and quietly hopeful: Jordan credits recent good things not to the job situation resolving, but to opening up to Dev, Mom, and Lena instead of trying to disappear.
